provider.role: Residency-program intelligence: program identity, stable IDs, evidence, provenance, freshness

consumer.module: missionmed-file-vault-ps (WordPress sibling plugin, behind File Vault)

authority.duplicateAuthority: NONE: the consumer caches bundles for 10 minutes and stores, per run, the exact bundle it wrote from as an audit snapshot; it never edits, re-ranks or republishes program facts

dataDirection.riseToFileVault: program data only (identity, facts, provenance, exclusions by code)
dataDirection.fileVaultToRise: NOTHING. Requests carry a program id or a search string and the student's own RISE session; no statement text, preferences, run data or File Vault identifiers

currentTransport.description: Server-side GET from WordPress to the existing RISE student routes, forwarding the signed-in user's own RISE session (browser cookie mmhq_rise_session sent upstream as mmhq_session), exactly as the existing /rise/ route proxy does. The consumer projects the responses into ProgramEvidenceBundle v1.
currentTransport.riseChangesRequired: NONE (no RISE deploy, no RISE code change, no RISE table access)
knownGaps: Research facts arrive without claim ids on this transport; provenance is factId + field + provider + sourceUrl + retrievedAt
Student notes on the RISE list are received by the adapter and dropped before anything is stored or returned

replacementPath: RISE-native GET /api/rise/v1/me/ps-evidence/:id returning the same schema (PSV-0002 PKT-3)
Matrix ecosystem bus or gateway delivering the same schema
adapterBoundary: missionmed-file-vault-ps/includes/class-mmps-rise-client.php (transport) + missionmed-file-vault-ps/includes/class-mmps-evidence-bundle.php::project() (projection). Nothing else in the consumer knows how RISE is reached.

auth.model: The end user's own RISE student session, forwarded. No service credential, no shared secret, no cross-app database access.
auth.consumerGate: WordPress login + prototype allowlist; REST answers 404 outside the allowlist
auth.failureMode: No or expired RISE session -> 409 mmps_rise_session_required with guidance to open RISE once

identifiers.fact: factId = 'F-' + first 12 hex of sha256(field + content); deterministic
identifiers.candidate: candidateId = one server-enumerated rhetorical strategy key inside the immutable run output
identifiers.root: rootId + textSha256 (+ File Vault file id, version number, version uuid and storage sha256 when the ROOT came from File Vault)

idempotency.reads: All RISE provider calls are GET and safe to repeat
idempotency.generation: Each durable batch item has a unique idempotency key; a retry reuses the stored run and never repeats completed provider work
idempotency.save: POST /library is idempotent per runId: one run, at most one saved document

perFact: claimId and contentSha256 where the transport supplies them

versioning.rule: Additive changes keep v1. Removing or renaming a field, changing a meaning, or changing fact id derivation requires v2 with a new schemaId. Consumers must ignore unknown keys.
versioning.deprecation: A superseded version is served in parallel for at least one release cycle; its retirement date is recorded in this manifest before removal.
versioning.negotiation: The consumer refuses a cached or received bundle whose schema string is not the one it was built for.

researchOwnerHandoff.rule: Only a separately approved RISE-owner intake contract may accept reusable evidence into RISE

manualEdits.scope: PSV-private immutable paragraph revisions only; original AI candidate and ProgramEvidenceBundle unchanged
manualEdits.concurrency: parent-revision compare-and-swap under the same owner run/ROOT transaction lock as library approval
manualEdits.approval: explicit editRevisionId binds the current exact revision; changed prose remains unapproved without verified grounding and fresh similarity checks
manualEdits.canary: private drafts permitted; final canary library save disabled

namespaces.events: none emitted in the prototype; reserved prefix ps.program_specific.*

ready: contract-first schema with stable ids and explicit provenance
no shared tables or cross-app DB access
one-way data direction with an explicit NO for PS text into RISE
namespaced routes, tables, options and constants
toDoWhenMatrixLands: register this manifest with the ecosystem registry
emit ps.program_specific.* events through the ecosystem bus if the ecosystem wants them
move the allowlist to the ecosystem's entitlement service
